vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gina, Bessie, Patricia and Dominik met them at the door — 4 put down. Gina, Bessie, Patricia, Dominik are hurt.
🛡️ Gina, Patricia, Ava and Owen met them at the door — 4 put down. Gina, Patricia, Ava, Owen are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Grace just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gina, Patricia, Dominik, Owen and Elena met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gina, Patricia, Dominik, Owen, Elena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bessie just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dominik just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Patricia, Dominik, Ava, Elena and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Patricia didn't come back. Dominik, Ava, Elena, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Grace. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Big-Eyes is still frozen from your scream.
Grace strikes the Pack-leader Big-Eyes.
The Pack-leader Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Big-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Big-Eyes, Big-Eyes (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader Big-Eyes, Big-Eyes (packmate).
You catch Mara telling the fire about Grace. "You brought down Pack-leader Big-Eyes, Big-Eyes (packmate)." The story's already growing.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
